title: Closure-area limit sets and geometric phase on the shape sphere
exact_target: Study shape-space limit cycles, possible closure areas and connected components of closed three-body shape curves.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002546 (AIM-PHYSICS-0054). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 17.

status_qualification: The last question concerns realizable dynamical shape curves, not arbitrary loops for which homotopy already provides a deformation. The source leaves the topology and deformation class to be specified. The damaged area notation A0 is repaired. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
